messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I'm not surprised.
{07 14 00}I'm telepathic like that.

When you're as close as we
are,{01 00 00 05 00} you can just tell what 
the other person wants.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hm.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma pole üllatunud.
{07 14 00}Ma olen selline telepaat.

Kui olete nii lähedased kui
meie,{01 00 00 05 00} tead sa lihtsalt, mida
teine tahab.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} So that
animal knew that shirt was
worth a fortune, eh?
{07 14 00}I figure everyone can use
something decent in their
wardrobe, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00} Nii et see
loom teadis, et see särk on
varandust väärt?
{07 14 00}Ma arvan, et igaüks vajab
oma garderoobi midagi
korralikku, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
